newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 4.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 4.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:

* The Dow Jones industrial average lost 79.01 points, or 1.21 percent, to close at 6,442.69 on Tuesday. It was the blue-chip index's biggest one-day point drop since it fell 161.05 points on July 15 amid earnings jitters.

* Indonesian central bank governor Sudradjad Djiwandono said on Tuesday that the bank had no immediate plans to widen the rupiah/dollar band on which it bases its intervention in the foreign exchange market.

* The Jakarta Composite Index rose 4.64 points, or 0.75 percent, to end at 620.81 points on Tuesday as a wave of buying by overseas investors in Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) and a few heavyweight issues boosted overall market sentiment.
* Brokers said the market was likely to stay firm on Wednesday on expected sustained foreign buying.
* On Wednesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,346.00/46.40 in early trading against the opening of 2,346.10/46.40.
* Detergent manufacturer Unggul Indah Corporation on reports it planned to expand into the property sector.
* BNI on expected active foreign buying.
* Indosat on reports that recently proposed cuts in its international telephone rates could affect revenue.
* Astra Graphia on market talk that the firm was likely to announce a rights issue and that it had won a lucrative deal.
* Indofood on reports it planned to acquire its principal distributor Indomarco early next year.
